scope.basis: The candidate adds a derived WebGL product asset, first-frame poster and five-shot consumer-visible Animatic.
unaffected_claims: CFD, FEA, certification and maintenance behavior

claims.statement: The candidate delivers the real STEP-derived control-valve geometry as exactly six bounded commercial-shot runtime groups.
The actual rendered Animatic visibly delivers all five authored product-recognition beats in a continuous 16-second timeline.
A meaningful product image is visible before the GLB is usable and hands off only after the first rendered WebGL frame.

evidence_strategies.target: candidate page with an intentional 650 ms GLB request delay

claims.statement: The delivered runtime uses a sub-1 MiB six-primitive Draco asset, demand rendering and acceptable sampled pacing on the observed GPU.

evidence_strategies.target: Brave WebGL2 on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / D3D11

claims.statement: Consumer-facing copy stays within observed STEP identity and does not imply unsupported product performance or simulation.

evidence_strategies.target: source audit, five-shot copy and runtime page

evidence.summary: The 908,680-byte Draco GLB decodes to exactly six named nodes, six meshes, six primitives and 284,478 triangles.
Every required screenshot was viewed: complete monument, axial mechanism, cascade macro, six-system explosion and complete stable hero are all legible without product clipping.
All 480 canonical frames exist; the motivated occlusion relocation is recorded and frames 408–479 have identical final hero state.
With a deliberate 650 ms GLB delay, the decoded 1600x1000 poster remained visible at opacity 1 and changed to opacity 0 only after the runtime reported ready.

evidence.target: Brave WebGL2 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / D3D11
evidence.summary: The short sample recorded p50 16.6 ms, p95 16.7 ms, no frame over 33.3 ms, zero idle renderer frames and no console, page or network failures.

evidence.target: candidate rendered copy and source traceability
evidence.summary: Copy is bound to the DN80 CL2500 pneumatic cascade assembly labels and explicitly avoids CFD, performance, certification, fail-direction and maintenance claims.
The remote candidate points at commit 29c885637b0a89700580eb58543f191d4fa51acf and GitHub reports a clean merge state.

promotion_candidates.proposed_invariant: Every model-driven product story must keep a decoded product poster visible until the first usable WebGL frame.
promotion_candidates.rationale: The invariant is consumer-visible, deterministic under a delayed model request and directly prevents an empty loading state.
promotion_candidates.suggested_probe: Reuse the delayed-model poster handoff portion of scripts/capture_control_valve_animatic.mjs.
